class.name: KimodoPipeline
class.brief_description: Loaded kimodo text-to-motion model, held resident across generate calls.
class.description: Holds the [code skip-lint]kimodo_model[/code] handle so a batch of prompts reuses the loaded weights instead of paying [code skip-lint]kimodo_model_load[/code] per call. Two decode paths: [method generate_from_prompt] runs the full text encoder plus denoiser, while [method generate_from_embedding] runs the denoiser alone against a precomputed [KimodoLatent], matching the "stages pass latents" rule.

method.name: load
method.description: Load the kimodo model. Required key [code skip-lint]motion_gguf[/code]. Optional keys: [code skip-lint]text_gguf[/code] (required for [method generate_from_prompt], unused for [method generate_from_embedding]), [code skip-lint]text_adapter_gguf[/code], [code skip-lint]threads[/code], [code skip-lint]device[/code] (0 auto, 1 CPU, 2 Vulkan). Returns [code]true[/code] on success; on failure pushes the reason through [method @GlobalScope.printerr] and leaves the pipeline unloaded.

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [method load] has succeeded and [method unload] has not been called since.

method.name: last_error
method.description: Returns the loaded model's last error string, or empty when nothing has failed since load.

method.name: unload
method.description: Release the loaded model. Safe to call more than once. The destructor also calls this.

method.name: generate_from_prompt
method.description: Full text-to-motion. Runs the internal text encoder against [param prompt], then the denoiser. Requires [code skip-lint]text_gguf[/code] to have been supplied at [method load]. [param opts] carries the generation knobs. Returns a Dictionary with [code skip-lint]frames[/code], [code skip-lint]joints[/code], [code skip-lint]local_rotations_xyzw[/code] and [code skip-lint]root_positions[/code]; empty on error.

method.name: generate_from_embedding
method.description: Denoiser-only. Consumes a precomputed [KimodoLatent] and runs the denoiser without loading the text runtime. The honest latent-stage decode: the caller supplied the embedding, so the pipeline decodes it once. Same return shape as [method generate_from_prompt]. Refuses when [member KimodoLatent.embedding] size is not exactly 4096.
